notes.title: Galactic Chef Update Livestream
notes.notes:
Galactic Chef has had a lot of big updates, with more coming soon. I'll play through the latest version of the pilot episode, show off some of what's new, and answer as many questions as I can!

For anyone new to Galactic Chef, this is a game all about mastering unfamiliar ingredients in procedurally-generated seasons of a cooking competition show from another galaxy. To win the title of Galactic Chef you'll need to beat the clock and out-score NPCs with their own procedurally-generated dishes.

Thanks to random generation, I'll be playing with ingredients I've never seen before. Let's see how long it takes me to beat my own game! If there's time left over after the pilot episode, I'll explore a bit of the full-season mode preview.

notes.title: Play through a sci-fi cooking competition show in Galactic Chef
notes.notes:
Thoughtquake Studios are currently developing Galactic Chef, a fun spin on cooking games with a sci-fi theme where you take part in a competitive cooking show.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/08/play-through-a-sci-fi-cooking-competition-show-in-galactic-chef
